goals.text: Launch claims automation for the Motor line
Reach 40% straight-through processing (STP) for eligible claims
Keep claims processed within SLA at or above 95%
Roll out the Home line in Q4 FY2026

achievements: Claims automation went live for the Motor line in November
Straight-through processing improved for the second consecutive quarter (42% vs 40% target)
Adjusters trained on the new workflow
Leadership confirmed budget for the Home line rollout
challenges: December claims peak pushed SLA performance below target
Complaints rose, mainly about status notifications not sent for automated claims
risks: If the historical data migration slips beyond February 2026, the Home line rollout may be delayed
Key-person dependency: only one Orion analyst maintains the automation rules

action_items.text: Fix status notifications for automated claims
Assign a second automation rules analyst

notes: Fiscal year: Q3 FY2026 = calendar Q4 2025 (Oct-Dec 2025); the normalized period must be calendar-based. Customer is Orion, not the consultant Helix. Previous-QBR actions marked Done are achievements, not open actions; the in-progress migration is the same item as the next-step migration (one action). 'by Jan 31' is after the Dec 2025 period end -> 2026.
